about: Wallet-provider lane falsifiers merged by tasks 010 and 004 (PRs #62 and #63). WP01 restores a temp-directory fallback when base_path is missing, WP02 accepts an empty root the same way, and WP03 replaces the non-absolute refusal with the same temp fallback; the named storage-root test then fails in each case. WP04 replaces the profile's `(deny default)` with `(allow default)`, and WP05 appends `(allow network*)` beside the profile's existing `(deny network*)`; those are the two profile falsifiers proven by task 004. A falsifier counts as caught only when every named test fails. Unit-test names of the form `tests::<module>::<fn>` resolve under `src/tests/` and must be registered in the unit test executable; bare integration-test names resolve against `tests/confine.rs`, which is a separate binary. Edit file paths are relative to examples/agent-host, the runner's rule. This list records the three storage-root refusals, the two profile mutations above, and the shared-contract mutations from task 014: WP06 drops the explicit `(deny network*)` requirement from the one check, and WP09 skips a missing required did profile. Task 018 re-anchors WP07 to drop the model profile from the one required list, retires WP08 and WP10 because the model-only branch they broke no longer exists, and registers WP26, which skips a missing model profile as NotFound. WP11 from task 015 removes the did profile's shared `STORAGE_PARENT` read grant, which the one contract check requires even though no did confinement test needs it. WP12 removes the network-allow rule from the one check while the shared predicate stays, and WP13 narrows that predicate to the exact form `(allow network*)`; `file_profile_contract_rejects_a_network_allow` catches each one. WP05's appended `(allow network*)` also fails `both_file_profiles_bind_one_storage_parameter_contract`, because the one check runs over the real wallet profile. Task 016 removes every allow form from this profile that no confinement test needed on macOS 26.5.2 arm64 (the program-image read, the three system-library subpaths and the `/dev/urandom` read) and registers the five allow rules it keeps: WP14 drops the shared process-exec grant, WP15 the root-directory read, WP16 the kernel-fact read, WP17 the shared `STORAGE_PARENT` read and WP18 the storage-root state grant. Each edit leaves the profile well formed and is caught only when every listed test fails. WP18 is the removed storage-root write rule that CONFINEMENT.md documents. Task 020 registers the appended `(allow default)`: WP19 removes the allow-default refusal from the one check while the shared predicate stays, and WP20 appends `(allow default)` after the profile's default denial; `file_profile_contract_rejects_an_allow_default` catches WP19, and WP20 fails `profile_denies_network`, `both_file_profiles_bind_one_storage_parameter_contract`, `confined_outside_read_is_denied` and `confined_outside_write_is_denied`. Task 021 registers the one check's canonical-token rule and the three profile falsifiers against it: WP21 removes the token refusal from the shared check, WP22 renames wallet's `STORAGE_ROOT` and WP23 renames did's, and WP24 appends the sibling-read allowance. `file_profile_contract_rejects_a_non_canonical_token` catches WP21; `both_file_profiles_bind_one_storage_parameter_contract` catches WP22 and WP23 and the token in WP24; `confined_outside_read_is_denied` catches WP24's granted key read. Task 024 registers WP25: the honesty test resolves edit paths from the repository root again, so `falsifiers_list_is_honest` fails on WP01's missing file and `falsifiers_list_rejects_a_repository_relative_path` fails because the WP01 refusal does not come. Task 027 adds WP27, which returns `Ok(false)` from the sandbox gate's declared-OS branch, so a missing `/usr/bin/sandbox-exec` on macOS skips and passes; `sandbox_gate_fails_instead_of_skipping_on_a_declared_os` fails on its `macos` case. Task 029 adds WP28, which starts the provider binary directly when the profile file is missing so the startup refusal test times out on the bounded wait, and WP29, which drops the child's standard error from the one failure message so the startup refusal test loses `sandbox-exec`'s line. Task 050 adds WP30, which returns `false` from the error arm of `sandbox_available`, so a missing `/usr/bin/sandbox-exec` on macOS returns and the test passes; `sandbox_available_fails_for_macos_when_sandbox_exec_is_missing` fails. Task 054 registers WP31, which restores the plain cut at every `;` and the parenthesis count inside strings, and WP32 to WP37, which disable escaping, whitespace inside a string, whitespace collapse outside strings, a comment's end at its newline, and the two parser refusals; `file_profile_contract_reads_strings_and_comments_as_sandbox_exec_does` catches WP31 to WP35, `profile_forms_rejects_unclosed_string` catches WP36, and `profile_forms_rejects_unclosed_form` catches WP37. WP38 drops the newline that ends a comment, so the tokens around it glue together and pass the check; `a_comment_inside_a_form_keeps_its_tokens_apart` catches it. WP39 drops the split outside every form, so a bare value such as `1` glues onto the next form and hides an `(allow default)` from the check; `a_bare_top_level_value_is_its_own_form` catches it. WP40 adds the separator space after an opening parenthesis, so `( allow default)` escapes both allow predicates and passes the check; `a_space_after_the_opening_parenthesis_still_names_its_rule` catches it. Task 053 adds WP41, which starts the stderr drainer only after the wait, so the fixture blocks on a full pipe and `stderr_is_drained_before_wait` fails on its exit assertion; WP42, which makes `unanswered` use a fixed `Operation not permitted` instead of the child's standard error, so `startup_denial_reports_its_reason` fails on its `execvp()` assertion; and WP43, which returns the shared unanswered message from the invalid-JSON branch, so `invalid_json_answer_names_the_request_and_the_parse_error` fails. Task 055 registers WP44, which appends `(allow file-read* (literal "/etc"))` to the did profile, WP45 to WP48, which drop the removal check's `expect`, profile-path, `old` and `new` conditions, and WP49 to WP53, which turn its profile-read, profile-parse, list-read, not-JSON and missing-list refusals into skips. Run the whole listfrom the repository root with `python3 -I examples/agent-host/falsify.py --from capsules/wallet-provider/falsifiers.json`; the sandbox entries need `/usr/bin/sandbox-exec`, so a full run is a Mac gate. Task 058 appends WP54, which drops the canonical-parameter refusal in `start_with_profile`, so `start_with_profile_refuses_a_canonical_parameter` fails. Task 058's encoding repair adds WP55, which checks the caller's whole name instead of the name before the first `=`, so `start_with_profile_refuses_an_encoded_canonical_parameter` fails. Task 059 appends WP56, which appends an unpinned `(allow process-exec)` after the exec rule, so `unbound_copy_is_refused_under_profile` fails on its deadline assertion. Task 060 appends WP57, which widens the parent read from `literal` to `subpath`, so `planted_key_beneath_storage_parent_is_not_read` fails because the planted key loads and `init` answers ok. Task 061 appends WP58, which drops the section check's own-id rule; `falsifier_section_check_reports_missing_and_stale_ids` catches it. WP59 drops that check's unregistered-id rule, which the same test catches. WP60 matches an id as a substring instead of a whole token, which the same test catches. WP61 runs the section to the end of the file instead of the next `## ` heading, which `falsifier_section_check_rejects_a_document_without_its_section` catches. WP62 bypasses the missing-heading refusal, which the same test catches. WP63 bypasses the duplicate-heading refusal, which the same test catches. WP64 skips an unreadable `CONFINEMENT.md` instead of refusing it, and `falsifier_document_read_rejects_unreadable_source` catches it. The same task names every registered id in its own document's `## Falsifiers` section and checks both documents with `every_falsifier_id_is_named_in_its_confinement_document`. Task 062 appends WP65, which appends `(allow file-write* (subpath (param "STORAGE_PARENT")))` to this profile, so `confined_outside_write_is_denied` fails because the fresh base beneath the parent is created. Task 063 appends WP66, which restores the silent drop of an entry without a string id in the one list reader, so `allow_rule_removal_check_rejects_bad_inputs` fails because that entry is skipped instead of refused. Task 064 appends WP67, which drops the section check's character-before rule, so `XDID1` names `DID1`, and WP68, which drops its character-after rule, so `DID1a` names `DID1`; `falsifier_section_check_reports_missing_and_stale_ids` fails on the matching case because the missing-id problem does not come. Task 066 appends WP69, which disables the second-exec-allow refusal in `check_profile_contract`, so `file_profile_contract_rejects_a_second_exec_allow` fails because the `/bin/sh` fixture passes. WP70 reads no `)` as a token boundary in the exec predicate, so `process*)` is neither `process*` nor `process-exec`; the same test fails on its `(allow process*)` case because that profile passes. Task 067 extends the exec predicate to every operation name of an allow form and narrows the refusal to every exec allow except the shared rule, and registers WP71, which quotes every exec allow after the first, WP72, which reads only the operation names before the first filter, WP73, which quotes only the first extra rule, WP74, which counts a token inside a nested filter, and WP75, which counts text inside a string; `file_profile_contract_rejects_a_second_exec_allow` catches each. Task 067's second round reuses `profile_characters` as the exec predicate's one string reader, accepts a filter directly after `allow`, and registers WP76, which drops the escape flag in `profile_characters`, and WP77, which requires a space after `allow`; `file_profile_contract_rejects_a_second_exec_allow` catches both, and `file_profile_contract_reads_strings_and_comments_as_sandbox_exec_does` catches WP76. Task 068 adds WP78, which renames the did-provider test the operations table cites, so `every_operations_table_cites_existing_tests` fails on the missing function. WP79 bypasses the unresolved-file refusal; `operations_table_check_reports_each_missing_citation` catches it. WP80 bypasses the no-citation refusal; `operations_table_check_reports_each_missing_citation` catches it. WP81 bypasses the absolute-path refusal; `operations_table_check_rejects_paths_outside_provider` catches it. WP82 bypasses the resolved-path containment refusal; `operations_table_check_rejects_paths_outside_provider` catches it. Task 069's WP83 renames the wallet operations table's cited `confined_outside_write_is_denied` test in `capsules/wallet-provider/tests/confine.rs`, so `every_operations_table_cites_existing_tests` fails because the cited function is gone. Task 070 adds WP84, which appends an allow rule to the did profile that no declared right names, and WP85, which appends the same rule to the wallet profile; `every_did_and_wallet_allow_rule_traces_to_one_declared_right` catches both. Task 073 adds WP86, which renames the one platform-baseline key the declared-rights check reads to the old startup-needs key, and WP87, which drops the justification refusal; `every_did_and_wallet_allow_rule_traces_to_one_declared_right`, `model_declared_rights_read_on_the_did_and_wallet_template` and `declared_rights_trace_refuses_each_bad_input` catch them. Task 072 adds WP88, which appends a read and write grant on `STORAGE_PARENT`, so `account_operations_beneath_storage_parent_are_refused` fails because the sibling `init` and the account call succeed. Task 074 adds WP89, which drops the pin table's two startup rows, so the swapped startup rules and the root read moved under `storage` pass, WP90, which drops the repeated-id refusal, WP91, which drops the repeated-rule refusal, and WP92, which drops the duplicate-form refusal, so the profile that holds `(allow sysctl-read)` twice reads the old reason; `declared_rights_trace_refuses_each_bad_input` fails on each case. Task 075 adds WP93, which drops the prefix refusal, so a justification that names another provider passes, and WP94, which drops the empty-reason refusal, so a bare provider prefix passes; `declared_rights_trace_refuses_each_bad_input` fails on the matching case. Task 076 adds WP95, which drops the role refusal, WP96, which drops the provider refusal, and WP97, which drops the platform-baseline status refusal, so each wrong value passes; `declared_rights_trace_refuses_each_bad_input` fails on the matching case. Task 077 adds WP98, which replaces the missing rights-list refusal with an empty list, WP99, which replaces the missing platform-baseline refusal with an empty map, and WP100, which replaces the missing baseline rules-list refusal with an empty list, so the check goes on and refuses later with other words; `declared_rights_trace_refuses_each_bad_input` fails on the matching case. Task 078 adds WP101, which replaces the missing-id refusal with an empty id, WP102, which replaces the missing-rules-list refusal with an empty list, WP103, which skips a rule that is not a string, and WP104, which drops only the pin table's `startup-sysctl` row, so `declared_rights_trace_refuses_each_bad_input` fails on its platform-baseline id case, its missing-rules-list case, its non-string-rule case and its sysctl-moved-under-storage case. Task 084 adds `managed_approvals_persist_under_storage_root` to WP18's tests, so the managed approval calls also fail when the storage-root grant is removed. Task 089 adds WP105, which makes the lab generator emit `(allow file-read* (literal "/private/var/cc-confine-generated"))` after the head, so `generated_did_and_wallet_profiles_match_their_committed_oracles` fails at the no-claimant refusal of the declared-rights check. Task 090 adds WP106, which makes the rights-list id refusal never fire, and WP107, which makes the platform-baseline id refusal never fire, so `generator_refuses_an_unnamed_right_and_the_start_is_refused` fails at its refusal check in the did case; WP108 makes the lab writer create the profile path before the generator refuses, so the same test fails on its no-file assertion. Task 091 adds WP109, which makes the lab generator append `(deny file-write* (literal "/private/var/cc-confine-generated"))` after the declared rules; only the sorted-tail oracle comparison catches it, because the profile head keeps its order and neither contract check reads a deny form, so the comparison fails on its `differs from its committed oracle` panic with that form under "only in generated". Task 093 adds WP110, which names `generate_profile` in `capsules/wallet-provider/src/main.rs`, so `lab_generator_is_named_only_in_test_code` fails because its walk reads a non-test file and its refusal names that path. WP111 names it in `capsules/did-provider/src/main.rs`, so the same test fails because the walk reaches the other crate.
